messages:
Priya S: Quick sync — Cloudway partner wants a short technical playbook & SSO checklist before the demo. Can someone take playbook ownership?
Alex M: I can. I'll assemble a 1-pager + runbook. Do we already have their SAML metadata?
Priya S: Yep, Ben from Cloudway emailed SP metadata earlier today. I'll drop it in the doc. Also they asked for explicit egress IPs and cert rotation policy.
Alex M: For egress IPs, we'll provide the NAT pool list from Dedicated. Cert rotation policy is standard 90-day; I'll add a one-liner.
Alex M: Quick sample snippet for recommended infra (so partner can prep):
```yaml
redwood_connect:
  mode: dedicated
  outbound_ips: ["35.203.45.10", "35.203.45.11"]
  tls_renewal: cron: "0 0 * * 0"
```
Dan R: @Sam (security) the partner questionnaire asks about data residency, customer-managed KMS, and SOC2 evidence. Can you handle?
Sam (security): On it. We support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments and HSM for on-prem. For Hosted we have envelope encryption; legal needs to approve customer-KMS terms. SOC2 PDF here: https://redwood.app/compliance/soc2.pdf
Mia K: Pricing question from Cloudway: they're asking for a blended pilot rate for first 3 months. Expected avg QPS ~30, burst up to 200 for ~10 minutes. Any quick guidance?
Dan R: Recommend offering a reserved-capacity pilot with burst credits. Suggest base commit = 2x expected sustained (so cover 60 QPS) + 30% pilot discount for first 3 months. I'll draft numbers and run by finance.
Priya S: Another request: auto-fallback behavior — partner wants an automatic degrade to a smaller model when we hit capacity. Can the runtime do that via routing policy?
Alex M: Yes. Smart routing supports fallback by cost/latency. Example route config for fallback: 
```json
{"routes": [{"preferred_model": "rw-large-v1","fallback": "rw-medium-v1","max_latency_ms": 1200}]}
```
Mia K: Timeline check — demo scheduled Wed morning. We need playbook, finalized SAML, and pricing by Tue EOD. Who's owning each deliverable?
Alex M: I'll own the playbook and the runbook doc. Will post draft link when ready.
Dan R: I'll own pricing and send the draft to finance/ops (cc @kevin).
Sam (security): I'll finish the questionnaire answers and attach the compliance artifacts. One partner ask: SIEM log retention 18 months — we offer 12 by default or enterprise add-on. Flagging legal.
Priya S: Ok blockers to escalate: (1) partner approval on SAML metadata, (2) final price sign-off, (3) public env IP list. If any of these slip, raise here.
Alex M: Uploaded draft playbook: https://redwood.app/drive/abc123 — please review, especially the SSO section.
Dan R: Draft pricing shared via doc link (sent to finance). Will update numbers after finance feedback.
Sam (security): Questionnaire completed and uploaded. Note: legal follow-up on long retention and KMS terms required.
Mia K: I'll coordinate the enablement session for partner infra team — proposing Thurs 10am PT (45m).
Priya S: Great. Quick sync tomorrow 11am PT to confirm final items. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
